messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: p95 latency > 600ms on /v1/generate (us-west-2-hostpool). Alerting SRE oncall. (sev2) :rotating_light:
alex_oncall: Acknowledged. seeing p50 ~80ms, p95 ~650-900ms, error rate +1.2%. Linking traces and perf counters now.
priya_sre: @alex_oncall jumping in. Any obvious deploys in last 30m?
alex_oncall: No code deploys in the last hour. Noted a kernel package upgrade on a small subset of dedicated nodes ~45m ago (kernel 6.4.19 -> 6.5.1). Not sure if rollout finished.
matt_runtime: I'm pulling tracing spans for a slow request. Traces show long time in "kv-cache::get" + high CPU sys time on gpu-proxy process. Span IDs: trace: https://traces.internal/r/3f7b2c
tracing-bot: Trace bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-traces/5301234567/tracebundle-3f7b2c.tar.gz
eng-platform: Router metrics: retries increased 4x on hostpool-2, circuit-breaker tripped on 3 nodes. Autoscale did not trigger due to reserved capacity limits.
alex_oncall: Customer impact: a few enterprise customers reported slow responses in the last 20m — CS alerted. @customer-support please prepare statement: "we're investigating latency, partial degradation"
customer-support: Noted. Drafting message, will send after we confirm root cause.
priya_sre: Hypothesis 1: kernel preempt change -> scheduler shifts -> more context switches affecting inference worker latency. Hypothesis 2: a recent network driver update affecting RPC tail latency. Need perf counters and kernel trace.
sre_lead: Prioritize getting perf counters (context-switches/sec, softirq, syscalls) and a perf record on a representative host. Also collect /proc/interrupts and dmesg for any OOPS.
matt_runtime: Collecting perf counters now (one host):
```
# perf stat -e context-switches,cpu-migrations,cycles,instructions -a sleep 30
 Performance counters for 30s
 context-switches  1,240,000
 cpu-migrations     42,000
 cycles           8.1e+09
 instructions     5.2e+09
```
priya_sre: That's ~41k migrations in 30s -> suspiciously high. Can someone reproduce with kernel 6.4.19?
eng-platform: I spun up a canary with 6.4.19 and ran the same load; p95 ~120ms, context-switches ~3200 in 30s.
alex_oncall: Good repro. Can we rollback kernel on the affected pool? What's the blast radius?
eng-platform: Affected pool: hostpool-2 (12 nodes). Rollback ETA ~18min if we use the automated image revert. Suggest mitigation: temporarily route traffic to hostpool-1 (spare capacity) and pause autoscale for hostpool-2.
priya_sre: While rollback is in flight, let's enable local KV caching bypass for long tails (TTL=0) to avoid stale lock contention — quick patch pushed to runtime.
matt_runtime: Patch deployed to routers in 2m. Monitoring for p95.
tracing-bot: New traces uploaded after patch: s3://redwood-traces/5301234567/postpatch-1.tar.gz
alex_oncall: Early signs: p95 dropped from 850ms -> 220ms on routed traffic to hostpool-1, overall p95 for /v1/generate improved to ~280ms. Error rate returning to baseline.
customer-support: Sending status update: "We routed traffic and are mitigating a performance regression; engineers are rolling back a recent kernel update. No data loss; some slower responses experienced."
sre_lead: Keep rollback in parallel; we need kernel OOM/irq messages from dmesg on 3 impacted nodes for RCA. Also collect perf top and a flamegraph if possible.
matt_runtime: Collected dmesg excerpt:
```
[  123.456789] BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 22s
[  123.456800] NMI watchdog: BUG: not syncing
[  124.000000] audit: type=1701 audit(1670000000.000:123): auid=1000
```
priya_sre: soft lockup + high migrations aligns with scheduler preempt/yield changes in new kernel. I'm leaning Hypothesis 1 as primary.
eng-platform: Rollback started on hostpool-2 (3/12 completed). Will update progress.
alex_oncall: Can we get a perf trace around the rpc thread? `perf record -g -p <pid> -o /tmp/perf.data -- sleep 20` and flamegraph upload.
matt_runtime: perf record ran on one node, flamegraph uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/5301234567/flamegraph-node7.svg
priya_sre: Flamegraph shows increased scheduler wait/put_task_state and sys_sched_yield samples — consistent with preempt-driven churn.
sre_lead: Action items: (1) Finish rollback for hostpool-2 and validate p95 on all traffic; (2) Open kernel regression ticket with vendor, attach perf and dmesg; (3) Add a canary gating for kernel updates to our rollout pipeline; (4) Postmortem with timeline and customer impact.
alex_oncall: Marking incident: mitigated at 5301234625 (p95 back to ~210ms), rollback complete at 5301234638. Will start timeline doc.
customer-support: Sent final update to affected customers. No escalations.
priya_sre: Adding quick note: during mitigation we saw autoscale constraints limit removal of load from affected nodes — recommend policy change to allow emergency burst shift.
eng-platform: Noted. Filing infra policy change.
sre_lead: Good work team. Please add logs/traces to the incident tracker and start RCA doc in #incidents-rca.
alex_oncall: Will write the timeline and link artifacts: traces, perf, dmesg, kernel package list. Closing oncall shift now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
